texts.preamble: Sh. Ravi Tickoo S/O Sh. S.K. Tickoo vs Food Safety Officer on 28 March, 2023 In The Court Of Mr. Dharmesh Sharma Principal District & Sessions Judge / Food Safety Appellate Tribunal; New Delhi District Patiala House Courts : New Delhi Fsat No. 17/2022 Cnr No. Dlnd010074492020 1. Sh. Ravi Tickoo S/o Sh. S.K. Tickoo R/o A101 Ff Plot No. 12, Udyog Vihar, Cghs, Sector12, Dwarka, Delhi110077 2. Rajesh Subramaniam S/o Sh. Karpan Subramaniam R/o H.No. 455C, Sunlight Colony, New Delhi110014 3. Vijay Kumar S/o Sh. Surendra Prasad R/o I121, Basement, Lajpat NagarIII, Delhi110024 4. M/s. Rsvk Restaurant Pvt. Ltd. G72, Ff, Outer Circle, Connaught Place, New Delhi110001 .....Appellants Versus Food Safety Officer Department of Food Safety Govt. of Nct of Delhi, 8th Floor, Mayur Bhawan, Shanker Market, Connaught Place, New Delhi110001 ...... Respondent Date of impugned order : 25.02.2022 Date of institution : 02.09.2022 Date of Judgment : 28.03.2023 Fsat No. 17/22 Ravi Tickoo & Ors v Fso Page 1 of 7 Appearances: Sh. Rekha Sharma, Advocate for appellant. Sh. Manoj Kr. Garg, Ld. Chief Pp for State/FSAT. Judgment:
texts.facts: FACTUAL MATRIX: 2. In a nutshell, appellant No.4 is a company and running a Restaurant having its registered office at G72, First Floor, Connaught Place, New Delhi110001 and the appellant No.1 Sh. Ravi Tickoo is the FBOcum Chef while appellant Nos. 2 and 3 are the Directors of appellant No.4. It is stated that on 12.09.2019 at about 6.30 p.m. Smt. Anjali Bhardwaj, Food Safety Officer alongwith the then FSO Sh. Pankaj Kumar Meena visited the premises of M/s. Lord of Drinks for random inspection and appellant No.1 readily cooperated with them providing them access to the premises including the Kitchen and dining area and the FSO purchased four portions of 'Kabuli Chana' for analysis, which were ready for use in preparation of 'hummus (Lebanese dish) and no price was paid since the sample was not for direct sale. It is stated that on 08.04.2021 a complaint was filed by FSO, namely Sh. Kuldeep Singh Suman against the appellants as per Rule 3.1.1.(3) of the Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011 but no notice or summons was issued to the appellants and without opportunity of hearing the impugned order dated 25.02.2022 was passed imposing not only consolidated penalty upon the appellants but also Mr. Satya Narayan Sharma, who was found to be Proprietor and Packer of the food item. The impugned order is assailed by the appellant Nos. 1 to 4 inter alia on the grounds that the Ld. AO/ADM failed to consider that the appellants were not manufacturer of the product and the 'kabuli chana' was not meant for direct sale and was for ultimate consumption; and that the Ld. AO/ADM passed the impugned order in a mechanical manner overlooking the fact that FSO while collecting the sample on 12.09.2019 filledup form VA wherein all the details of the food item including label declaration such as batch number, net weight, expiry date, date of packing/manufacturing, license number, and best before period were clearly spelled out and yet the Ld. AO/ADM held that food item was 'misbranded'. 3. It is pertinent to mention here that the FSO in the complaint dated 08.04.2021 stated that on lifting the samples of the food item viz. Kabuli chana for analysis price of the same amounting to Rs. 1400/ was offered but it was not accepted and four sealed packets each weighing 2 kg of food item viz. Kabuli chana were taken as samples and the same was sent to Food Analyst, Government of Delhi for analysis, who vide report No. FSS/ 1377/2019 dated 20.09.2019 opined that sample was 'misbranded' because there were galore violations with regard to Regulation No. 2.2.1.5, 2.2.1.7, 2.2.2.1, 2.2.2.4, 2.2.2.6, 2.2.2.7, 2.2.2.8, 2.2.2.9 and 2.2.2.10. On filing of the present appeal on 02.09.2022 the operation of the impugned order was stayed subject to the appellants depositing/furnishing Demand Draft/FDR in the sum of Rs. 50% of the fine/penalty imposed by the Ld. AO/ADM and the said order has been complied with. Notice was issued to the respondent and although no reply is filed, the appeal is opposed and the record of the Ld. AO/ADM is produced.
